PortPinion.notes: Partial source-counted roller pinion: 73 rotating leaves, four shaft-assembly leaves, two separate bushes and nineteen named mounting leaves per side. Casting profiles, counterbores, end journals, M1546 bearing, oil drilling and nominal pipe-thread envelopes are inferred. Inner Q52E plug is cut flush per HB132; outside head retained. Cotters are unsplayed supplied-length approximations; formed retention is unqualified. Static angle 17.21 degrees and explicit 1.8033 mm inward station correction clear the existing 35-tooth hypothesis at one position. Continuous gearing, 35/37 tooth conflict, detailed lubrication/sealing, threads and full shared-part quantity reconciliation remain unresolved.
